data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
wilmington_nc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.8868, 34.2104])  # Wilmington, NC coordinates
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2018-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation
precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(wilmington_nc)

# Check if collection has data
if precip_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate annual precipitation sum
    annual_precip = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Extract value at Wilmington location
    precip_stats = annual_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=wilmington_nc,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    precip_mm = precip_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    # Check for valid result
    if precip_mm is None:
        print("No valid pixels at location.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif precip_mm < 0 or precip_mm > 10000:  # Unreasonable range check
        print(f"Invalid precipitation value: {precip_mm}")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert mm to inches
        precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4
        
        # 5. Check condition and output answer
        print(f"2018 Annual Precipitation: {precip_inches:.1f} inches")
        print(f"Target: 90 inches")
        
        if precip_inches >= 90:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
